problem:
Let the vectors $v$ and $w$ be orthogonal. 
If $|u\cdot v{|}^{2}+‖v+w{‖}^{2}=50$ and $‖u‖=‖w‖=4$, then what is the minimum possible value of $‖v‖?$

activity_context.topic_title: The Pythagorean Theorem and the Triangle Inequality

feedback.problem: Given that $‖3u+v‖=18$ and $‖u‖=5$, find the smallest possible value of $‖v‖.$
feedback.worked_solution:
Using the triangle inequality, we have that

$$
\begin{aligned}‖3u+v‖ & \le 3‖u‖+‖v‖.\end{aligned}
$$

Simplifying and substituting in the given information, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}‖3u+v‖ & \le 3‖u‖+‖v‖ \\ 18 & \le 3\cdot 5+‖v‖ \\ 18 & \le 15+‖v‖ \\ 3 & \le ‖v‖.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the smallest possible value of $‖v‖$ is $3.$
